question: The Satavahanas were a powerful dynasty in _______ India.
solution:
The correct answer is **South**__**.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satavahanas** was a powerful dynasty that ruled in various parts of India from around **230 BCE to 220 CE.**
 
• **They were mainly located in the Deccan region of India, which includes present-day Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, and parts of Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat.**
 
• The Satavahanas were known for their **efficient administration**, patronage of** art and literature**, and trade relations with foreign countries.
 
• **They also played a significant role in spreading Buddhism and Hinduism in the regions they ruled.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **eastern part of India **was mainly ruled by the **Mauryan and Gupta **dynasties during the Satavahana period.
 
• The** northern part **of India was mainly ruled by the **Mauryan, Gupta, and Kushan** dynasties during the Satavahana period.
 
• The Satavahanas were mainly located in the **southern** part of India, particularly in the** Deccan region**.
